```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggh4x)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)
library(here)

source(here("R/utils.R"))
```

## Load data from 01_data_load

```{r load-rds}
rtB4rar              <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "rtB4rar.rds"))
rt_g                 <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "rt_g.rds"))
curto_unrar_otutab   <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "curto_unrar_otutab.rds"))
genus_unrar_otutab   <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "genus_unrar_otutab.rds"))
genus_min_sample     <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "genus_min_sample.rds"))
metadata             <- readRDS(file.path(RDS_DIR, "metadata.rds"))
```

## Curtobacterium alpha diversity

```{r curto-alpha-compute}
alpha_diversity_table <- calc_alpha_diversity(
  otu_table      = curto_unrar_otutab,
  n_iterations   = N_ITER,
  sequence_depth = RAREFY_DEPTH_CURTO,
  set_seed       = SEED
)

curto_divdf <- cbind(alpha_diversity_table, rtB4rar@sam_data)

cat("Mean richness:", mean(curto_divdf$Richness), "\n")
cat("SD richness:",  sd(curto_divdf$Richness),    "\n")
cat("SE richness:",  sd(curto_divdf$Richness) / sqrt(nrow(curto_divdf)), "\n")
```

### Shannon diversity — away reserves

```{r curto-shannon-away, fig.width=28, fig.height=10}
ggplot(curto_divdf |> filter(reserve_code != "LOMA"),
       aes(x = Substrate_reserve, y = Shannon, fill = i_code)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  facet_nested(~ reserve_code + Bag_type + s_home, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = inoc_colors, name = "Inoculum") +
  xlab("Litter substrate") +
  ggtitle("Curtobacterium alpha diversity — away reserves") +
  apatheme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Shannon diversity — Loma Ridge

```{r curto-shannon-loma, fig.width=16, fig.height=7}
ggplot(curto_divdf |> filter(reserve_code == "LOMA"),
```

### Shannon by bag type

```{r curto-shannon-bagtype, fig.width=28, fig.height=7}
ggplot(curto_divdf,
       aes(x = Bag_type, y = Shannon, fill = i_code)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge()) +
  facet_nested(~ reserve_code + Bag_type, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +

  apatheme +
```

### Normality check

```{r curto-normality}
hist(curto_divdf$Shannon, main = "Shannon distribution — Curtobacterium", xlab = "Shannon")
```

### Statistical tests — Curtobacterium

**Note:** Before accepting the ANOVA results, check residuals for normality and
homoscedasticity. The LMM (m1) is preferred here as it accounts for the random
effect of reserve.

```{r curto-anova}
# Type II ANOVA on closed bags only
shann_anova <- car::Anova(
  aov(Shannon ~ reserve_code * s_home + i_home,
      data = curto_divdf |> filter(Bag_type != "Open")),
  type = "II"
)
shann_anova

# Residual checks
aov_mod <- aov(Shannon ~ reserve_code * s_home + i_home,
               data = curto_divdf |> filter(Bag_type != "Open"))
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(aov_mod, which = 1:2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r curto-lmm}
# Mixed model: reserve as random effect
m1 <- lmer(Shannon ~ s_home + i_home + (1 | reserve_code),
           data = curto_divdf |> filter(Bag_type != "Open"))
anova(m1)
summary(m1)
```

## Bacterial genus-level alpha diversity

```{r genus-alpha-compute}
# Bug fix: use genus_unrar_otutab (not curto_unrar_otutab) for genus-level diversity
alpha_diversity_table_g <- calc_alpha_diversity(
  otu_table      = genus_unrar_otutab,
  n_iterations   = N_ITER,
  sequence_depth = genus_min_sample,
  set_seed       = SEED
)

genus_divdf <- cbind(alpha_diversity_table_g, rt_g@sam_data)

cat("Mean genus richness:", mean(genus_divdf$Richness), "\n")
cat("SD genus richness:",  sd(genus_divdf$Richness),    "\n")
cat("SE genus richness:",  sd(genus_divdf$Richness) / sqrt(nrow(genus_divdf)), "\n")
```

### Shannon diversity — away reserves (genus)

```{r genus-shannon-away, fig.width=28, fig.height=10}

  facet_nested(~ reserve_code + Bag_type + s_home, scale = "free", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = inoc_colors, name = "Inoculum") +
  xlab("Litter substrate") +
  ggtitle("Bacterial genera alpha diversity — away reserves") +
  apatheme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),

```

### Shannon diversity — Loma Ridge (genus)

```{r genus-shannon-loma, fig.width=16, fig.height=7}
ggplot(genus_divdf |> filter(reserve_code == "LOMA"),
```

### Statistical tests — genus level

```{r genus-anova}
shann_anova_genus <- car::Anova(
  aov(Shannon ~ reserve_code * s_home + i_home,
      data = genus_divdf |> filter(Bag_type != "Open")),
  type = "II"
)
shann_anova_genus

aov_mod_g <- aov(Shannon ~ reserve_code * s_home + i_home,
                 data = genus_divdf |> filter(Bag_type != "Open"))
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(aov_mod_g, which = 1:2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r genus-lmm}
m2 <- lmer(Shannon ~ s_home + i_home + (1 | reserve_code),
           data = genus_divdf |> filter(Bag_type != "Open"))
anova(m2)
summary(m2)
```

```{r save-rds}
saveRDS(curto_divdf,            file.path(RDS_DIR, "curto_divdf.rds"))

saveRDS(alpha_diversity_table_g,file.path(RDS_DIR, "alpha_diversity_table_g.rds"))

message("02_alpha_div: all objects saved to ", RDS_DIR)
```
